About me

Profile

I make the dough and prepare the station so the kitchen is ready before the first order comes in.

I have hands-on experience in Italian, Turkish and Nepali kitchens, with dough for pizza, lahmacun, pide and momos. I control fermentation, hydration and proofing so every dough ball has the same texture and rise. I work cleanly, follow HACCP, and stay precise when the kitchen is busy.
